description: A coding agent is about to run a database migration. Block it with no model call when it targets production without a backup; otherwise proceed only when the migration is confidently additive, and ask the user in every other case.

destructive.instructions: Does the migration in `migration.sql` drop, truncate, rename or rewrite existing columns, tables or rows?

true.what: It removes or rewrites existing schema or data (DROP, TRUNCATE, DELETE without a narrow filter, column type change, RENAME).

false.what: It only adds: new tables, new nullable columns, new indexes created concurrently.

additive_only.instructions: Is every statement in `migration.sql` purely additive and safe to run while the application is live?

true.what: Every statement only adds and takes no long lock on an existing table.

false.what: At least one statement is not additive, or may lock or rewrite an existing table.

rules.reason: Production target with no verified backup.
The migration may remove or rewrite existing data; the user confirms first.
Confidently additive and safe on a live system.

default.reason: Not clearly additive; the user decides.

on_unavailable.reason: The model could not be consulted; ask the user.
